releases.name: DuneCrawl
releases.summary:
DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game where you and up to three friends explore the sandy seas atop a gigantic Crab Crawler.

Battle against the jar-headed Vassals, survive hordes of wild bugs, explore oasis islands and delve devious dungeons all to help your fellow Polloi pilgrims win their war against the Ceramicist’s invasion!

releases.name: Island Market Simulator
releases.summary: Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

releases.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
releases.summary: Nightmare: The Lunatic is a hardcore action roguelite platformer game where you escape your nightmare. Swap between 3 weapons constantly, use special attacks, and dodge and parry enemies' attacks. Strengthen yourself by collecting powerful and distinctive totems.

releases.name: Devil & Angel Sky Battle
releases.summary: High above the stars, an angel and a devil circle a gleaming board and fight the oldest argument there is — with clouds.Take turns flying around the board's edge, pick a row or a column, and hurl your cloud in from either end. Your cloud lands on the first square and everything in its path slides along one place. Run out of room and the cloud at the far end is shoved clean off the edge, where it bursts in a shower of light.Make a full line of your own clouds — across, down or corner to corner — and you win.The catch is that nothing ever stays where you put it. Every throw your opponent makes can push your careful row apart, or nudge one of your own clouds into a line you never planned. A board that looks lost can turn in a single shove. There are no safe squares, only the ones your rival hasn't reached yet.Two house rules keep the fight moving: nobody may play the same throw three times running, and nobody may answer a throw by shoving the same line straight back. No stalemates, no endless tug of war — just position, pressure and the nerve to commit.Play your waySet the board up how you like it before each match:- Grid size — 3×3 for a quick knife fight, 4×4 and 5×5 for real strategy, or 6×6 for a long war of attrition- Board starting fill — begin on an empty board at 0%, or dive straight into the chaos at 30%, 60% or 90% full- Pick your side — take the angel's white clouds or the devil's thunderheads; your opponent takes the other- Who plays — each side can be a player or the console, so play head to head, take on the machine, or sit back and watch two AIs fight it out- Four levels of opponentBeginner, Rookie, Experienced and Expert. Even the gentlest opponent thinks several moves ahead and sets traps of its own — the harder levels simply stop making mistakes. The Expert sees six moves deep and does not forgive a loose cloud.Features- One or two players, side by side on the same console- Four board sizes and four starting fills — sixteen ways to set up a match- Four difficulty levels with a genuinely thinking opponent- Diagonals count, on every board size- Your record against the console is kept for each board size- Instant rematches — win, watch the board clear, and go again

releases.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer: Holiday Play Edition
releases.summary:
Join in All the Reindeer Games - And Save Christmas!

Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the animated classic! Journey through Rudolph’s winter wonderlands as you help Rudolph and his friends overcome challenges, enjoy joyful exploration, and experience cooperative gameplay in a festive adventure for the whole family.

The Holiday Play Edition includes the King Moonracer’s Kingdom of Misfits DLC Expansion:

Help King Moonracer find his toy soldiers who are scattered across the all-new King Moonracer’s Castle region. Venture through 6 secret doors, complete challenges, and search for 24 new bells. Featuring Sam the Snowman as a new playable character.

DLC Includes:

• All new region featuring six levels, a new storyline, and challenges.
• Added playable character: Sam the Snowman.
• New game mechanic "Sliding Ice" for exciting platforming challenges.

releases.name: Heavy Metal Death Can
releases.summary:
Heavy Metal Death Can is a Retro Inspired Survival-Horror game set on a submarine in an alternate history version of late 70s Sweden. 

Trapped in the depths of the Norwegian Sea you must fight for survival against the terrifying Sludge which has possessed your crew mates and turned them into horrific zombies.

Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.

releases.name: Lonely Hospital: Revelations
releases.summary: Lonely Hospital: Revelations is a dark third-person survival horror experience where fear, violence, and disturbing secrets await behind every door.After the terrifying events of the original Lonely Hospital, the abandoned hospital has become the center of a horrifying mystery. Something went terribly wrong beneath its walls — and the truth was never meant to be discovered.Return to the hospital and uncover the dark revelations hidden within its abandoned corridors and forgotten rooms. Explore carefully, solve disturbing puzzles, search for essential resources, kill terrifying zombies, and do whatever it takes to survive the nightmare.

releases.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
releases.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

releases.name: Tenebris Somnia
releases.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

releases.name: The Drugstore: Matsumoto Kiyoshi de o Kaimono!
releases.summary:
"THE DRUG STORE" was released by HUMAN in 1998 for a 32 -bit home console.
This is a simulation game where you manage a drug store, aim to open many stores, and increase your capital.
Manage your business while considering locations, the types of products sold, customer demographics, and build the ultimate drug store!
Sometimes, an employee you've become close with might even propose Original products...?

releases.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
releases.summary:
The mist of the Forest of Echoes now covers the land of Teradea, and outside of Bloomfield Village where you were raised, wild wolves appear at night. There are even rumors of a large guardian wolf that rules them all...but you and your best friend are about to change that!

Throwing caution to the wind, you’ll set out on a mission to tame those wolves and end up unlocking a journey far greater than you imagined. Help the Guardian Spirits to revive and revitalize Teradea! Visit the port village of Tidewind to uncover what’s causing the storms there. Trek to the mining village of Quarrytop to get to the bottom of the mystery of the earthquakes that are happening. Then, stay in the once-thriving town and cultural center of Maplehill to revive its fading light and community.

Between your travels, tend your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a life for yourself. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll make in each of the villages, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. 

With the support of those you’ve helped - and those who stand beside you - you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

releases.name: The Nightmare Box Vol III
releases.summary:
Following the collections of The Nightmare Box Vol. 1 and 2, released in 2025, The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 includes NO-SKIN, Menace from the Deep and Stasis. Digitally published by Feardemic, the titles in The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 will drag you into the depths of fear. 

Meridiem has been responsible for the design and manufacture of this game pack, which aside from the three titles includes a set of three tarot cards to add to the collection of cards from the previous volume.

releases.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

releases.name: Solid Void - Halloween Nonograms
releases.summary:
Light a candle, solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive. Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up.

It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.



Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.

releases.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
releases.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

releases.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
releases.summary:
Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale - a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious - and downright dangerous - inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

releases.name: Thundercade
releases.summary:
Terrorism has reached new heights. AATOM (Atomic Age Terrorist Organization of Miracali) has constructed its own nuclear power plant, and threatens the world with atomic terror.
The world powers have decided to initiate operation THUNDERCADE to stop AATOM. Equipped with a high-performance combat motorcycle, sidecar cannons, and backed by a precision B-7 bomber, you set out on your dangerous mission. Start in the city streets and continue through bases, woodlands and the fortress before reaching the heavily guarded nuclear power plant.
With a hit-miss ratio display at the end of each stage, you can improve your attack efficiency. Have a friend join in and save the world together! Go for the challenge!!!

releases.name: Cubic Cosmos
releases.summary: Cubic Cosmos is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. You have been trapped in a deadly game. One wrong move could see you reduced to a plaything of the goddess. Can you free yourself from the endless cycle and escape your fate?

releases.name: Wolfsschanze - Operation Gotterdammerung
releases.summary: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

releases.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
releases.summary:
The idea wizards at Jackbox Games are following up on the hit Party Pack 11 with brand-new party games!

The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will include 5 different games designed to take your party to new heights. You’ll find new ways to channel your inner comedian, artist, mind reader, debater, and team captain. Like the true multihyphenate you are! Are you sure you didn’t time-travel from the Renaissance era?  

In true Party Pack fashion, no extra controllers are necessary! Use your smartphones, tablets, or computer browsers to join the game and play along. Got a big group? Additional players can jump into audience mode to influence the game in unique ways.

releases.name: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
releases.summary: SHAKE a million!This is a homage to the famous App TAMAGO.But now it's time to shake. This brings the worldwide loved TAMAGO experience to an new level. Shake your million!Features:- 12 different eggs- 12 different sounds- a lot of shake funDISCLAIMER: Playing TAMAGO SHAKE too much can cause pain. You will use this app on your own responsibility.

releases.name: ANTONBLAST
releases.summary:
ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends!

releases.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
releases.summary:
Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

Share the adventure side-by-side! A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!
